title: Currencies: shards and candies
summary: Shards are the money of Overrank; candies are the seasonal currency of the Halloween event.

blocks.text: Shards are the one currency of the game. You earn them everywhere and spend them on gear and services.
blocks.html: Shards are the one currency of the game. You earn them everywhere and spend them on gear and services.

blocks.text: Candies only exist during the Halloween season. They come from Haunted Castle clears and from candy pickups, and you spend them at Grimble's Candy Bazaar (chests, a direct buy, the title Halloween 2026).
